source_refs.note: Exercise 9.2, Question 8 (book p. 272); the book prints no answers for Exercise 9.2; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Yeh \(\tan^{-1}\) ka jama hai, lekin ek term ke saamne 2 hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{7}\) aur \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\).
Find kya karna hai? Jama \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) dikhana hai.
Rule kaunsa? Pehle \(2\tan^{-1}x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1-x^{2}}\), phir jama wala formula (v).
Plan: 2 hatao, phir do terms jorr kar \(\tan^{-1}1\) tak pahuncho.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{7} + 2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\).
Maloom karna (prove): yeh \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ke barabar hai.
Tareeqa: double formula \(2\tan^{-1}x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1-x^{2}}\) (jo \(-1 < x < 1\) par sahi hai) se \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) ko ek akela \(\tan^{-1}\) banayenge; phir formula (v) \(\tan^{-1}x + \tan^{-1}y = \tan^{-1}\frac{x+y}{1-xy}\) se jorenge. Yeh Question 6 jaisa hi pehla qadam hai.

2 ko hatayein
\[2\tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{3}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{2 \cdot \frac{1}{3}}{1 - \frac{1}{9}}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{2/3}{8/9} = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{3}{4}\]
Kyun: \(x = \frac{1}{3}\) \(-1\) aur 1 ke darmiyan hai, is liye formula jaiz hai. Upar \(\frac{2}{3}\), neeche \(1 - \frac{1}{9} = \frac{8}{9}\). Divide yani ulta kar ke multiply: \(\frac{2}{3} \cdot \frac{9}{8} = \frac{18}{24} = \frac{3}{4}\).
Dhyan dein: neeche \(x^{2} = \frac{1}{9}\) hai, \(\frac{1}{3}\) nahi; square karna mat bhooliye.

Formula (v) se jorein
\[\text{L.H.S} = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{7} + \tan^{-1}\tfrac{3}{4}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{\frac{1}{7} + \frac{3}{4}}{1 - \frac{1}{7}\cdot\frac{3}{4}}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{25/28}{25/28} = \tan^{-1}1\]
\[= \tfrac{\pi}{4} = \text{R.H.S}\]
Kyun: shart \(xy = \frac{3}{28} < 1\) poori hai. Upar: \(\frac{1}{7} + \frac{3}{4} = \frac{4 + 21}{28} = \frac{25}{28}\). Neeche: \(1 - \frac{3}{28} = \frac{25}{28}\). Upar neeche barabar, fraction 1, aur \(\tan^{-1}1 = \frac{\pi}{4}\).

Tasdeeq
\[0.1419 + 2(0.3218) = 0.1419 + 0.6435\]
\[= 0.7854 \approx \tfrac{\pi}{4}\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: calculator (radian mode) se bhi \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) aaya. Ghor kijiye: \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) ki value \(\tan^{-1}\frac{3}{4}\) ke barabar 0.6435 hi hai.
Yeh sawal aur Question 6 milte julte hain: dono mein pehle double formula, phir jama. Is pattern ko pehchaan lena aadha hal hai.
